overview:
Mark Messmer, the Republican incumbent, is running for reelection in a southwestern Indiana district that leans heavily Republican, with a partisan advantage of about 18 points. He has raised more than $1.1 million and holds a substantial cash-on-hand lead over Democrat Mary Allen, who has raised under $300,000. No general-election polls or expert ratings are available for this race.

Prediction markets give Messmer roughly a 96% chance of winning, consistent with the district's fundamentals. With no evidence of a competitive race, the forecast treats this as safely Republican, with the incumbent favored by a wide margin.
